build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for mixture-of-experts molecular MLIP
merge_mole_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into a single linear layer for efficient single-dataset inference
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific MOLE experts based on dataset names
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares a single prediction head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
review_mole_coefficients_routing: review the set_MOLE_coefficients method that computes expert mixing coefficients using composition and CSD embeddings
